headline: Ghana Inflation Rises to 5.5% in October
summary: Ghana's headline inflation increased to 5.5% in October 2026, up from 5.2% in September. The rise was driven primarily by higher costs in the transport and services sectors.
why: Inflation data is a critical indicator for central bank policy and investor sentiment regarding the stability of the Ghanaian economy.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Rising inflation erodes purchasing power and may necessitate tighter monetary policy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Inflation data influences central bank interest rate decisions, which impact currency value and sovereign debt yields.
